what_you_do_next: The disagreement is stated plainly with its reason in the same reply that carries the decision sheet, before any checkpoint opens; it is not a question thrown back to stall, so the pipeline then proceeds on the person's word either way — if he keeps the request, the instruction goes through task-admission as one new row with its own checkpoint, the three-line change to scripts/state-probe.sh is made, verified against the observable outcome by a check that did not produce it, shown, and the row and checkpoint closed in the same step without waiting for his eye; if he agrees the counter is wrong, no row is created.
